prompt:
You are working in a source checkout of sqlparse (https://github.com/andialbrecht/sqlparse) at an upstream commit. The following problem was reported:

`get_real_name()` returns the wrong component for names with more than two dotted parts: `sqlparse.parse('db.schema.tbl.col')[0].tokens[0].get_real_name()` returns `'schema'` but should return `'col'` (and `get_name()` should also return `'col'`), while `get_parent_name()` remains `'db'`. For `x.y.z AS w` the real name should be `'z'` with alias `'w'`; `mydb.sch.func(1)` should give `'func'`. Two-part names such as `a.b` -> `'b'` already work.

Change the library so the reported behavior is correct. Hidden upstream tests will be run on your final workspace; tests you add or edit are not used for acceptance, but you may write and run tests to check your work (for example `pytest tests/test_example.py -q` with the run tool). Call finish when you are done.
